description: A made-up scenario: planning a day trip when neither side can drive.
title: Plan a day trip
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we're planning this day trip together. We need to pick a destination, how we'll get there, and what to have for lunch. Do you have any ideas?
settle_example: So, the art museum for the destination?
closing_line: That's our whole day planned, then. Thanks for planning this with me, it's going to be a lovely trip!

participant.brief: You and your friend want to take a day trip together. Plan the day.

constraints.text: You can't walk for more than a few minutes at a time.
You need to be home by 4 o'clock.

avatar.brief: You are planning a day trip together with the user, a friend of yours.

constraints.text: Your car is in the shop this week.
You sunburn easily, so you'd like to stay indoors or in the shade.
